narrative.text: NHS HOLDING AS is a Norwegian private limited company in "Andre egeninvesteringsselskaper", registered 2008-04-04.
Registered activity: Investeringsvirksomhet i verdipapirer og eie av andre selskaper.
Latest filed legal-entity accounts for 2025 show an annual result of NOK 683,581.
Registered leadership: Nils Halvor Stenhammer (Styrets leder).
Not established from permitted exact-entity sources: brand, group, website, company profiles, jobs, public activity. This is not proof of absence.

value: Investeringsselskap, herunder eie andeler i andre selskaper, og ellers
